tournament.name: February OCC - Qualifier B
tournament.description: Participation Confirmation deadline: FEBRUARY 11th Qualifier Brackets - February 12th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline February 12th @ 1200 GMT) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season. Round of 8 Finals - February 19th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline February 17th @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
